label: Земля
description: Twelve-mission case drill for земля (earth, land, ground) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The base form земля is the subject of вращается, so it stays in the nominative. Soft feminine nouns in -я keep that ending in the nominative singular.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. After нет the noun shifts to genitive земли, where the soft ending -я becomes -и. Negated existence with нет is a standard genitive trigger.

missions.phrase: К этой земле они относятся бережно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative singular. The preposition к governs the dative, turning земля into земле with the soft dative ending -е. The dative marks the entity toward which the attitude is directed.
Strategic focus: Accusative singular. As the direct object of пашут, земля takes the accusative землю; soft feminine nouns change -я to -ю in the accusative singular.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The preposition над requires the instrumental, so земля becomes землёй. Because земля is end-stressed, the ending is the stressed -ёй rather than -ей.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. Locative на takes the prepositional, and земля becomes земле with the soft ending -е, matching the dative form. The phrase на земле marks the location.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural. As the subject of принадлежат, the plural земли carries the soft nominative ending -и instead of singular -я. Soft feminine nouns mark the nominative plural with -и.

missions.phrase: В этом крае много плодородных земель.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural. After много the count noun goes to genitive plural земель, a zero ending where a fleeting е appears between the consonants. Quantity words like много govern the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The preposition по governs the dative plural землям, with the plural dative ending -ям after the soft stem. Here по marks the territory the border runs across.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. As an inanimate direct object of обрабатывали, земли has an accusative plural identical to the nominative plural. Inanimate feminine nouns keep accusative plural equal to nominative plural.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The preposition между governs the instrumental, giving землями with the plural ending -ями after the soft stem. The instrumental plural ending is uniform across declensions.

missions.phrase: В дальних землях живут другие народы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. After в the noun takes the prepositional plural землях, ending in -ях after the soft stem. The prepositional plural ending is the same for all genders.
